items.title: Hackers heat French supermarket fridges, sparking fires and spoiling food
items.summary: A large-scale attack raised temperatures of connected refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets to 50°C, causing fires and food losses. ANSSI is investigating, and threat intel firm Sekoia says Spain, Portugal, Poland, Germany and Belgium were also affected.

items.title: SAP Security Patch Day fixes four critical flaws, including a CVSS 10.0 in Cloud SDK for Python
items.summary: SAP's October 2026 patch day addressed 20 CVEs on October 13, four of them critical. CVE-2026-89111, a server-side request forgery flaw in the SAP Cloud SDK for Python with a CVSS 10.0 score, can let an unauthenticated attacker exfiltrate OAuth2 client credentials.

items.title: Splunk patches critical 9.8 flaw allowing unauthenticated remote command execution
items.summary: CVE-2026-76268 affects the Patroni REST API on Splunk Enterprise search head cluster members, where missing authentication leaves critical configuration operations exposed to attackers with network access. Fixed in Splunk Enterprise 10.4.3 and 10.2.7.

items.title: H&M investigates cyber attack claims as string of fashion brands hit
items.summary: H&M is investigating claims by the Xuanye group following a similar incident at ASOS last week, while Hobbs, Phase Eight and Whistles confirmed a cybersecurity incident through their parent company The Foschini Group.

items.title: Google's October Android update patches seven critical security vulnerabilities
items.summary: Google's October Android security bulletin fixes seven critical flaws, one in Framework (CVE-2026-58865, remote denial of service) and six in System, including local privilege escalation issues requiring no additional execution privileges or user interaction.
